en.headline: Kwun Tong waterfront hosts Mid-Autumn carnival today
en.dek: The Kwun Tong District Arts and Culture Promotion Association stages games, workshops, magic, dance and Sichuan opera face-changing at AquaBeat 01 on the harbourfront.
body: A Mid-Autumn carnival is being held today at the Kwun Tong waterfront activity space AquaBeat 01, organised by the Kwun Tong District Arts and Culture Promotion Association under the theme of celebrating the festival early with family and friends.

The programme includes lantern riddles, handicraft workshops, magic shows, dance performances, popular music, pickleball experience and Sichuan opera face-changing, according to organisers and local listings.
The one-day event offers free or low-cost family activities on the harbourfront. Residents interested in taking part were advised to check the venue for the day's schedule and any capacity limits.

zh.headline: 觀塘海濱今日舉行中秋繽紛嘉年華
zh.dek: 觀塘區文娛康樂促進會於AquaBeat 01舉辦提早慶祝中秋活動，設燈謎、手作、魔術、舞蹈及川劇變臉等節目。
body: 觀塘區文娛康樂促進會今日於觀塘海濱活動空間AquaBeat 01舉行「觀塘中秋繽紛嘉年華」，以提早與家人朋友共度中秋為主題。
活動包括燈謎遊戲、手工藝工作坊、魔術表演、舞蹈表演、流行曲、匹克球體驗及川劇變臉等節目。
是次為單日活動，提供免費或低收費親子項目。有意參加的市民可到場查詢當日時間表及名額安排。
